name: Free Hand Defense (Combat)
body:
By always keeping one hand free, you can better confound your attackers. You keep your foes guessing with a dizzying array of thrusts and parries as you switch your weapon from one hand to the next.

Prerequisite(s): Dodge.

Benefit(s): When you wield a light- or one-handed weapon and your other hand remains empty and free, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to your Armor Class. This dodge bonus increases to +2 when taking the total defense action. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Bluff when attempting to feint against an opponent.
